verdict.rationale: Marqeta's velocity controls docs explicitly support amount and frequency limits per user, enforced platform-side ('the user cannot exceed any of the defined spending limits'), and authorization controls allow merchant-based restrictions, both platform-enforced rather than in customer code. Marketing and MCP docs reiterate 'spending caps' and 'velocity limits' as first-class platform features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of distinct daily/monthly/all-time window granularity and per-cardholder vs per-card distinction, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
